scripts.db:up: docker start hrms-postgres 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name hrms-postgres --restart unless-stopped -e POSTGRES_USER=hrms -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=hrms -e POSTGRES_DB=hrms -p 5433:5432 -v hrms-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:16-alpine
scripts.setup: npm run db:up && npm run mail:up && npm run db:migrate -w api && npm run seed -w api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.mail:up: docker start hrms-mailpit 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name hrms-mailpit --restart unless-stopped -p 1025:1025 -p 8025:8025 axllent/mailpit:v1.21.8
